channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: UM's Derek Moore wins GSC Player of the Year, makes All-GSC team with Fussell, Curry
item.description: The University of Montevallo's Derek Moore was named the Gulf South Conference Player of the Year and joined his teammates Brandon Fussell and Jaylen Curry on the All-GSC team.

item.title: Thompson alum Bradley Franklin runs fastest 60m hurdles time in D-I with Samford
item.description: Thompson alum Bradley Franklin ran the fastest 60-meter hurdles time in the country to win the SoCon indoor championship with Samford and advance to the NCAA championship.

item.title: Chelsea’s Ty Cason, Hudson Williams sign distance scholarships
item.description: Chelsea’s Ty Cason signed with Mississippi State track and field and Hudson Williams signed with Wallace State cross-country at a joint signing ceremony after their accomplished careers.

item.title: Pelham Athletics Hall of Fame inducts seven-member class of 2025
item.description: Pelham inducted its seven-member Class of 2025 for the Pelham Athletics Hall of Fame, including Chris Adams, Justin Allison, Emily Bell Casey, Lauren D’Alessio Marsh, Patrick McDonald, Michael Proctor and Seth Torman.

item.title: Pelham High School celebrates ‘Golden’ tradition at 2026 Miss PHS pageant
item.description: Pelham High School’s annual Miss PHS pageant graced the school auditorium for another exciting edition on Saturday, Feb. 28, with Maddie Rasco being crowned as the winner.

item.title: TIS STEM Night planned for March 11
item.description: Thompson Intermediate School will be full of educational activities during TIS STEM Night.

item.title: Chelsea reflects on run back to Birmingham after Final Four loss to Hazel Green
item.description: The Chelsea Hornets fell in the Final Four to Hazel Green, but they did so after a stellar run to Birmingham behind many of the experienced scorers behind their run to becoming a perennial contender.

item.title: Calera falls short in Final Four overtime loss to Cullman to finish strong season
item.description: The Calera Eagles dropped a heartbreaking comeback loss to Cullman in overtime, but the team expressed pride in their hard work and fighting spirit to finish a strong season with a return to the Final Four.

item.title: Festival of Tulips blooms at peak as 10th annual celebration draws thousands to Montevallo
item.description: The American Village’s Festival of Tulips has reached peak bloom, making it the perfect time to attend one of Shelby County’s signature events amidst its 10th anniversary.

item.title: Briarwood falls to Guntersville after accomplishing Final Four goal
item.description: Emotions filled the Briarwood Christian Lions after their semifinal loss to Guntersville, but they held their heads high through defeat after achieving their Final Four dreams and making the most of their opportunity.
